# RewardsPro API foundation

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/rewardspro-api)

Receive verified Shopify commerce events, persist an idempotent inbox and project supported orders through a worker.

**Scope:** Backend foundation; does not claim legacy RewardsPro feature, data or business-rule parity, and does not mutate a financial ledger.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/rewardspro-api`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Fastify routes, PostgreSQL repositories, migrations, webhook normalization and worker code are present. The README specifies event retention, immutable metadata and optional SQS delivery.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Extend only the supported event contract with matching repository and worker tests; validate migrations against the documented local PostgreSQL fixture before any separately authorized deployment.
